profile.summary: Michael's Transportation Service, Inc. is a bus transportation company based in Vallejo, California. It provides home-to-school service, activity and field trips, athletic trips, employee shuttles, longer trips, and bus leasing. It serves school districts and other customers in the Bay Area and Central Valley.
